description: Defines the ContextHostResolver class, a wrapper for HostResolverManager used within the net namespace, providing methods for DNS resolution requests, cache management, and testing utilities.

classes.name: ContextHostResolver
classes.description: A wrapper class for HostResolverManager that manages DNS resolution requests and cache, designed to be used within a URLRequestContext.

methods.name: ContextHostResolver
methods.description: Constructors for creating a ContextHostResolver, either forwarding requests through an existing manager or owning its own.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Handles shutdown procedures for the resolver.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a DNS resolution request based on host information and parameters.

methods.name: CreateMdnsListener
methods.description: Creates an mDNS listener for a specified host and query type.

methods.name: GetDnsConfigAsValue
methods.description: Returns DNS configuration as a dictionary value.

methods.name: SetRequestContext
methods.description: Associates a URLRequestContext with this resolver.

methods.name: GetManagerForTesting
methods.description: Returns the HostResolverManager for testing purposes.

methods.name: GetTargetNetworkForTesting
methods.description: Returns the network handle for testing.

methods.name: LastRestoredCacheSize
methods.description: Returns the number of cache entries restored.

methods.name: SetTickClockForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom tick clock for testing.
